  - temperature also follows a weekday cycle;
  - PV is non-zero in exactly 06:00–18:00 all year and peaks at 18:00.

| Rebuilt from CN01 minus the other buildings | exact | — | — |

- **Simpler detectors:** a single global threshold (z-score or IQR) misses about a third of the faults (F1 ≈ 0.80).
- **Linear-only reconstruction** after detection gives *worse* cluster centres than not cleaning at all, because long bridged gaps form their own flattened cluster.
- **What the clusters capture:** the three daily-load clusters (k = 3) split by weekday ({Fri, Sat, Sun}, {Mon, Thu}, {Tue, Wed}), not by season. A silhouette check actually prefers 2 clusters; I kept 3 as the protocol.
